blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) recently unveiled a greenhouse facility in Aklan province to improve high-value crop production. The Value Chain Enhancement of High-Value Crops through Smart Agriculture (VEHCSA) facility, situated at the Aklan Agri-Aqua Demonstration Farm and Training Center in Nalook, Kalibo, will use smart farming technology to enhance productivity.
